The fault is in [hasher.go](/app/utils/hasher/hasher.go:15): the hasher stores opaque, randomly generated `maphash.Seed` values per ID and exposes no `SetSeed` API. A caller therefore cannot supply a seed or restore one after reseeding. The existing [tests](/app/utils/hasher/hasher_test.go:16) pass, but do not cover either behavior.

The fix should add the requested exported `Hasher` and package and method `SetSeed` interfaces, use the supplied seed string when hashing that ID, and retain automatic initialization for IDs without a seed. Tests should verify that setting, changing, and restoring a seed produces the expected hashes. A global `maphash` seed may make results reproducible within a process; stability across process restarts needs clarification.

**No project source or tests were edited.** This run was constrained to fault localization. I recorded the findings in [checkpoint.md](/app/.codex-role-output/checkpoint.md).

Added exported `Hasher` and package and method `SetSeed` APIs. An ID now keeps its assigned seed, so changing it changes the hash and restoring it restores the original hash. IDs without a seed are initialized automatically.

Hasher, race, database, and persistence tests pass. Hashes are reproducible within a `Hasher` instance; the `maphash` seed is process local, so identical results across restarts are not guaranteed.

VERDICT: FIX

**Code defect:** [hasher.go](/app/utils/hasher/hasher.go:34) creates a random `maphash` seed for every `Hasher`. As a result, setting the same ID and explicit seed in a fresh instance or process does not reliably reproduce the same hash. The added [tests](/app/utils/hasher/hasher_test.go:19) check restoration only within one instance. Use a deterministic hash based on the supplied seed and input, and verify reproduction across instances.

**Tests:** `GOPROXY=off GOSUMDB=off GOTOOLCHAIN=local go test ./utils/hasher`, `go test -race ./utils/hasher`, and `go test ./db ./persistence` all passed with the same offline environment variables. `git diff --check` passed. TEST_ENVIRONMENT_PROBLEM: none.

Fixed the hasher’s cross-instance reproducibility issue. It now hashes the supplied seed and input deterministically, so restoring a seed restores the same hash. Added a test that checks matching results across fresh `Hasher` instances.

The reviewer’s offline hasher, race, DB, and persistence tests all pass. `git diff --check` passes. No test environment problems remain.
